newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Mentakab Rubber seeks stock suspension.
newsitem.headline: Mentakab Rubber seeks stock suspension.

text.p: Mentakab Rubber Co (M) Bhd said it has requested a suspension in the trading of its stock, effective Tuesday, pending an announcement.
In a statement sent to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange late on Monday, the oil palm and rubber concern said the announcement would be made "in due course" to the exchange. It did not elaborate.
On Friday, the company's shares ended at 57 ringgit.
